note: YC hint confirmed: YC directory lists Browser Use (batch W25/Winter 2025, status Active, website https://browser-use.com) which matches the card's domain (browser-use.com). Founded 2024 by Magnus Müller (CEO) and Gregor Zunic (CTO), originally incubated via ETH Zurich's Student Project House before joining YC W25. Its open-source browser-use agent framework (110k+ GitHub stars per YC profile) is the basis for the commercial Browser Use Cloud product priced in the card. Only the $17M seed (Mar 2025) is publicly documented; no evidence of a later priced round as of 2026-09-30.
